title: Elixir OTP - things explainer
summary: A plain-word, picture-first notebook on Elixir OTP: private-desk processes, GenServer as a filled-in job description, let-it-crash supervision, supervision trees as blast-radius diagrams, and DynamicSupervisor + Registry for workers hired on the spot -- all built around one running multi-room notification-system example.

concepts.title: A Different Way to Build Software
Little Workers That Talk By Passing Notes
A Worker With a Job Description
Letting a Worker Fall Down Safely
Drawing the Family Tree of Who Watches Whom
Workers You Hire on the Spot
Errands, Timers, and Ways to Trip Yourself Up
Proving It Falls Down the Right Way

images.prompt: A hand-drawn practice-notebook sketch: ballpoint linework with red-pen annotation on cream ruled paper, slightly imperfect strokes, hand-lettered arrows and margin marks, a hint of tape or paper-clip realism. Warm and informal -- obviously drawn by a person, not rendered. Subject: a cutaway sketch of a spiral notebook page showing a friendly stick-figure "supervisor" holding loose threads that connect down to several small labeled boxes ("room: acme", "room: widgets-co", "task"), one box drawn crossed-out and mid-redraw to show a restart happening, red-pen arrows pointing at the restart with a handwritten note like "starts fresh!". No baked-in title text -- the app overlays the title. Generous margins, nothing important near the edges. Target size ~960x1280px, 3:4 portrait; the art is letterboxed into that box so keep the subject centred.
images.alt: A spiral-bound notebook page sketching a room full of little worker figures, each with its own thread back to a supervisor hand
images.caption: A supervisor doesn't do the work itself -- it just watches, and replaces what falls over.
